speaker: Doctor
text: I need to clarify your symptoms: does the severe leg pain make it difficult to walk, and have you noticed any redness, swelling, or warmth in the affected areas? Also, please tell me if you have had any recent injuries, insect bites, or exposure to sick contacts.

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old girl. The patient has been experiencing generalized fatigue and easy bruising for 3 weeks. Over the past week, she has developed a fever and severe leg pain that wakes her up at night.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Leukemia (Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia). The combination of prolonged fatigue, easy bruising, fever, and severe bone pain in a 4-year-old is highly suggestive of this malignancy; immediate full blood count and peripheral smear are required for confirmation.
